fcs_function.name: fcs/pitch-ratio-calc-0
fcs_function.description: Pitch Ratio: qbar schedule. 1:1 at low qbar, 1:6 at high qbar. ref: NASA TM 72861, MCAIR Eagle Talk

fcs_function.name: fcs/roll-ratio-dmd
fcs_function.description: Roll ratio scheduled by stabilator position (replaces linear Vc formula)

fcs_function.name: fcs/ari/mechanical-demand-norm
fcs_function.description: Mechanical ARI: rudder from lateral stick via stabilator position. Proverse gradient 0.55, adverse gradient 0.85. ref: NASA TM-72861 Figure 23, MCAIR Eagle Talk

fcs_function.name: fcs/ari/cas-demand-norm
fcs_function.description: CAS ARI: operates at all speeds, biased to 10deg AOA reference

fcs_function.name: fcs/differential-elevator-pos-norm
fcs_function.description: Differential stabilator: coupling factor 0.3 with Vc/stab schedule. Plus 0.4deg gun weight asymmetry bias.
